integrity: Two different standard-C++17 exhaustive finite functional-graph algorithms use independently specified isomorphic Frucht graph labelings, reproduce the joint 531441-state period table and agree on all primitive-orbit and maximal-entry counts. All necessary code and output are embedded in the finding record.
scientific_limitations: An exact finite-state classification only for the specified labeled Frucht graph and two deterministic update maps. An independent external mathematical audit and conclusive historical-priority verification have not been performed.
title: A 1,496-state period split between cyclic and excitable dynamics on the Frucht graph
